label: Login
usage_steps: Navigate to the login page at /login
Enter your email address or username in the 'Email or Username' field
Enter your password in the 'Password' field
Click the 'Sign in' button to authenticate
If credentials are invalid, an error message will appear
Click 'Create one' link at the bottom to navigate to the registration page

label: Register
usage_steps: Navigate to the registration page at /register
Enter your email address in the 'Email' field
Choose a username (3-30 characters, letters, numbers, and underscores only)
Enter a password (minimum 8 characters) in the 'Password' field
Re-enter your password in the 'Confirm Password' field
Click 'Create account' to register
If there are validation errors, they will appear below each field
Click 'Sign in' link to go back to the login page if you already have an account

label: Dashboard (Empty State)
usage_steps: After logging in, you are redirected to the dashboard
When no todos exist, an empty state message is displayed
Click 'Create Todo' button to add your first task
The header shows the app title and a logout button

label: Dashboard (With Todos)
usage_steps: The dashboard displays all your todos in a list view
Each todo shows its title, description, priority badge, and status
Stats cards at the top show total, pending, in-progress, and completed counts
Use the filter bar to narrow down todos by status or priority
Use the sort dropdown to reorder todos
Click the floating '+' button (bottom-right) to create a new todo
Click the checkbox to mark a todo as done
Click the trash icon to delete a todo

label: Create Todo Modal
usage_steps: Click the '+' floating action button or 'Create Todo' button
A modal dialog appears with a form
Enter a title for your todo (required, max 200 characters)
Optionally add a description for more details
Select a priority level: Low, Medium, or High
Optionally set a due date
Click 'Create Todo' to save, or 'Cancel' to dismiss

label: Filter by Status
usage_steps: Use the 'Status' dropdown in the filter bar
Select 'Pending', 'In Progress', or 'Done' to filter todos
Select 'All' to show all todos regardless of status
The todo list updates immediately when a filter is applied

label: Filter by Priority
usage_steps: Use the 'Priority' dropdown in the filter bar
Select 'Low', 'Medium', or 'High' to filter by priority
Select 'All' to show all todos regardless of priority
Combine with the status filter for more specific results

label: Sort Todos
usage_steps: Use the 'Sort by' dropdown on the right side of the filter bar
Select 'Due Date' to sort by upcoming deadlines
Select 'Created At' to sort by creation date
Select 'Default' to return to the default ordering

label: Delete Confirmation
usage_steps: Click the trash icon on any todo item
A confirmation dialog appears asking you to confirm deletion
Click 'Delete' to permanently remove the todo
Click 'Cancel' to dismiss and keep the todo
Note: This action cannot be undone

label: Complete a Todo
usage_steps: Click the circular checkbox on the left side of a todo item
The todo is marked as 'Done' with a green checkmark
The title gets a strikethrough style to indicate completion
Click the checkbox again to reopen the todo (mark as pending)
Stats cards update automatically to reflect the change
